role: larger signature containing a given signature
notes: Every symbol of the smaller signature keeps its kind and arity; reducts use the registered restriction operator.

role: agreement of named tuples on all formulas of a signature
notes: Tuples are indexed by one set, possibly empty or infinite; subscript dropped when both structures share the signature. Instance of registered elementary equivalence.

role: universal sentences entailed by a theory
notes: Set of sentences, not a subset of T; sentences of the theory's own signature.

role: sentences of a subsignature entailed by a theory
notes: Consequences of T, not the members of T that happen to lie in the subsignature.

role: model-theoretic algebraic closure of a parameter set
notes: Union of finite sets definable over X; a structure-relative operator, not an algebraically closed-field assumption.
